events.title: Reach for the stars in THE OMEGA REACH demo
events.summary: Greetings curators!I'm thrilled to share the demo of THE OMEGA REACH for Steam Next Fest. Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe!THE OMEGA REACH was originally created for Games for Blind Gamers 5. It offered a unique point-and-click experience that was made accessible through its tactile controls, expressive audio and haptics, and support for screen readers. events.title: Introducing THE OMEGA REACH
events.summary: Greetings curators!I'm excited to share THE OMEGA REACH with you for the Access-Ability Summer Showcase 2026!I initially created this project as a co-host for the Games For Blind Gamers 5 jam. The jam release culminated nearly 200 hours of development to introduce you to The Omega Conservatory and its core game loop of exploring the universe, finding your place in it, and killing time with music.
